The '''''Dark Revenge''''' was a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]] that served as the command vessel for the [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Dharus]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Dharus' Buccaneers]] utilized the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in their dealings along the [[Leisure Corridor]], attacking vessels and coming into conflict with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 9" />
